description.value: Rolling grasslands and dry open forest frame two turquoise fishing lakes—Kentucky and Alleyne—about 90 minutes from the central Okanagan; a staffed BC Parks frontcountry site open roughly April to late October with water standpipes and good highway access.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is BC Parks' official page for Kentucky-Alleyne Park, within which Forest Loop Campground (the OSM name) is a frontcountry campsite; the name 'Forest Loop Campground' does not appear verbatim on the fetched pages, but it is consistent with a named loop within the park. The page explicitly confirms water standpipes throughout the campground and prominently features a 'Book camping' link tied to the BC Parks reservation system, supporting reservations-accepted. The OSM operator phone (+1-250-320-9305) and email (parkinquiries@telus.net) are attributed to operator Brandywine Environmental Management Ltd. and are not corroborated on the fetched BC Parks pages, which list different central contact numbers.
concerns: The OSM name 'Forest Loop Campground' does not appear verbatim in the fetched BC Parks website content for Kentucky-Alleyne Park; it is presumably a named loop within the park but cannot be confirmed from available text.

The OSM phone (+1-250-320-9305) and email (parkinquiries@telus.net) are for park operator Brandywine Environmental Management Ltd., not BC Parks centrally; the fetched website pages do not corroborate these operator-specific contact details.
No civic address is recorded in the OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, operational BC provincial park campground in a scenic region popular with outdoor travellers. Touring cyclists riding the Okanagan/Thompson corridor would benefit from a listing that confirms water availability and the reservation system.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website safety rules note that motorcycles and bicycles are permitted on park roads only. The nearest sani-station is 25 km north in Merritt.
